description: A resource diagram lists future resource utilization (it starts at the current time).
An object of this type is related to the usage of a specific resource,
whose name is defined in the parent object (RUE_Type).
The list of resource diaram entries represents a diagram showing
is respresented by the the following table

attributes.name: amount
description: Amount of the resource which is used.

attributes.name: resource_map_list
description: Amount of Resource Maps which are used.

attributes.name: binding_inuse
description: Cores/threads that are used by jobs. Filled only if the resource is slots and when bookkeeping is done on host level.
